report.summary: The alert reproduces from the supplied expression: the checkout PlaceOrder server-span error ratio (5m rate of STATUS_CODE_ERROR / 5m rate of all statuses) exceeded 0.5 in two excursions inside 2026-10-13T05:16:54Z-06:17:53Z and stood at 0.875 at the 06:16:54Z anchor. The failure path is visible in spans and metric labels: checkout's PlaceOrder fails because its oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge call returns gRPC status 2 (Unknown), with the checkout span description 'failed to charge card: ... Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'; the matched payment server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge is flagged error=true with the same message thrown at /usr/src/app/charge.js:37. Payment's Charge error ratio has the same time shape and the same 0.875 end value as checkout's PlaceOrder ratio, and over the hour payment recorded roughly 19.32 error versus 57.97 unset Charge server spans while every other checkout dependency (cart, currency, product-catalog, shipping, quote) showed gRPC 0 / HTTP 200 in the sampled traces. User-facing effect is downstream: frontend /api/checkout and frontend-proxy returned 500, and load-generator POST spans errored (~19.3 of ~542). Unresolved: the cause of 'Invalid token'. Payment evaluated a flagd float flag only about 3 times in the hour, the flagd trace view could not be retrieved (INVALID_PARAMS), and one flagd evaluation bucket sits inside a fully healthy interval, so a flag/fault-injection origin remains a hypothesis.
